picks.editorial_note: An AI model designed custom bacteriophages used in the first-ever treatment of a patient with an antibiotic-resistant infection, demonstrating AI-driven drug design moving from theory into real clinical use.
picks.title: This time, the virus is on the patient’s side. AI helped design it

picks.editorial_note: CSIRO's AI imaging technique independently confirmed the landmark Event Horizon Telescope black hole image in a Nature publication, validating AI as a trustworthy tool for fundamental physics discovery.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a national-security scandal is triggering a U.S. government investigation, with major implications for AI hardware supply chains and industry leadership.
picks.title: Nvidia seeks successor after Jensen Huang's exit wobbles AI industry

picks.editorial_note: A $19 million state grant will let Texas Tech build a next-generation AI-integrated computing cluster for semiconductor research, a significant infusion for chip innovation infrastructure.
picks.title: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation | Texas Tech Now

picks.editorial_note: UC Riverside's role in the $4.8 million NSF-funded AERONET project will use AI-coordinated networks to improve aviation communication safety, a concrete real-world safety application.
picks.title: UCR joins $4.8 million aviation safety endeavor

picks.editorial_note: Indiana University's new Applied Research Center formalizes expanded government and industry partnerships on national security AI priorities, signaling deeper academia-government integration.
picks.title: Indiana University expands national security research partnerships through Applied Research Center

picks.editorial_note: Michigan Tech and UCLA researchers showed AI models for predicting materials' electronic structures need far less training data than assumed, a finding that could meaningfully accelerate materials discovery.
picks.title: Less Data, Faster Discovery: Researchers Rethink AI’s Role in Developing New Materials

picks.editorial_note: MIT's new quantization method addresses the KV cache memory bottleneck in large language models, a technical advance set for presentation at NeurIPS that could broadly improve LLM inference efficiency.
picks.title: Faster data compression through quantization

picks.editorial_note: Nokia's 1.5 million euro donation and expanded annual R&D commitment to Aalto University deepens industry-academia collaboration on intelligent, energy-efficient networking technology.
picks.title: Nokia donates 1.5 million euros to Aalto University and strengthens R&D collaboration | Aalto University

picks.editorial_note: A $1 million NSF-funded multi-university project led by Syracuse aims to create implantable medical devices that adapt to individual patients, pairing AI with biomedical engineering for personalized care.
picks.title: New Research Explores Medical Devices That Adapt to Each Patient
